messages:
ashley: Quick q — I'm planning to come back from parental leave 3 days/week for the first 8 weeks (Mon–Wed). How does that affect benefits enrollment windows and my Q4 performance check? worried about eligibility and manager expectations.

devin: Thanks for flagging, Ashley. Short answer: benefits stay active during approved leave; part-time return shouldn't break enrollment. Performance check timing is separate, but manager should document accommodation in the review notes. pinging @hr-legal and @lena for manager side.

people-ops: FYI you can file the partial-return request here: https://hr.redwood/return-request — select "reduced hours/part-time ramp". It routes to your manager + people ops.

hr-legal: Confirming: health/childcare FSA elections are locked for the plan year unless you have a qualifying life event. Reduced hours alone is not a QLE. If you need to change benefits because of dependent status, submit paperwork within 30 days of the event. Otherwise your current elections remain intact.

benefits-bot: automated reminder — benefits impact guide: https://benefits.redwood/docs/part-time-return. Addendum: prorated 401(k) employer match is based on compensated hours for the pay period.

lena: Ashley — I support the 3-day ramp. For the Q4 review: I'll schedule your review but note the accommodation and shift expectations. We'll do a 30/60 check-in to review workload. Also we can redistribute on-call for those first 8 weeks.

ashley: Perfect, thanks. One more: does reduced-week affect PTO accrual rate immediately or from the pay period after approval?

devin: Accrual updates apply from the start of the pay period that contains your approved return date. If the return is mid-pay-period we’ll prorate for that pay period. People-ops will confirm once the form is processed.

people-ops: Got it — processing now. ETA 2 business days. If you want a written summary for your manager / review folder I can generate one. :white_check_mark:

ashley: Yes please, that would be helpful. Can you include who covers on-call and the handoff notes? thanks :heart:

people-ops: Will do. Attaching checklist to the thread when ready. ```Return checklist:
- submit partial-return form
- manager ack + schedule update
- payroll update for accruals
- benefits guidance sent
- 30/60 check-in calendar invites```
